subject: Request: transient latency tolerance and one-time make-good credit for CinderEdge pilot
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@cinderedge.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot run - latency spike on Friday (request for tolerance + credit)

Tessa,

Thanks again for a solid week of support during our pilot. We ran a heavier workload on Friday to simulate production bursts and saw the 95th percentile latency jump from ~420ms to ~760ms during two 20-minute windows. Attached is the telemetry slice and the request log.

We know the SLO in the contract is 95th <= 500ms, and for the pilot we're prepared to be flexible, but operations needs a short-term tolerance while we adjust prompt batching and caching (estimated 10 business days). Specifically we're asking:

- A transient SLO tolerance to 95th <= 750ms for up to 10 business days starting Sept 10th
- A one-time make-good service credit if the 95th stays >700ms for more than two days in that window; we propose a single credit equal to 5% of September invoice as a compromise

We can provide additional logs and will collaborate on tuning. Please escalate to your deal desk / execs for approval so we can keep the pilot timeline.

Best,
Priya
Head of Engineering, CinderEdge

--
Attachment: CinderEdge_latency_report_q3-2027.csv (6.2 KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Priya Shah <priya@cinderedge.ai>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot run - latency spike on Friday (request for tolerance + credit)

Priya — thanks for the slice and the call yesterday. We dug into the trace and agree there's a burst pattern that likely triggered suboptimal batching on our side.

Internally, I'm recommending we:
- Enable prefix caching for the affected route immediately (we can do this tonight)
- Apply a conservative batching cap for 48 hours to stabilize latency
- Monitor 95th and 99th and share hourly reports with your team

I'll escalate the make-good/variance request to our deal desk and loop back. Can you confirm the business-critical window (are there any demos or go/no-go dates we should prioritize)?

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

My read: operationally reasonable if we can get a firm mitigation plan and bounded credit. Proposal for exec: approve temporary tolerance to 750ms for 7 business days (not 10) and a capped makeup credit of 3% of the monthly pilot invoice, contingent on joint remediation plan (prefix caching + batching cap + daily sync). We should attach the proposed remedy terms doc.

Can I get quick sign-off to present this to Deal Desk?

Marissa / Logan — legal reviewed the proposed_remedy_terms_v1.1.pdf. Key points to include in the approval:

- Language: 'one-time, non-precedent make-good credit, applicable only to the September 2027 pilot invoice for Deal ID CE-2027-PILOT-4134.'
- Limit: 3% cap as commercial proposed.
- Duration: tolerance window limited to 7 consecutive business days and must begin only after Redwood has deployed and verified the initial mitigation for at least 24 hours.
- Monitoring: CinderEdge must grant Redwood read-only access to the specific telemetry stream for the duration of the window and attend daily 30-minute standups.
- No SLA amendment: this is an exception for the pilot only and must be explicitly marked as 'not an amendment to the Master Services Agreement (MSA)'.

If everyone signs off, I'll draft the email to the Deal Desk and prepare the legal addendum wording to attach to the credit memo.

Subject: Approved: transient tolerance and capped make-good for CinderEdge pilot (next steps)

Priya / Ravi — thank you for the quick collaboration. Executive approval has been granted with conditions. Summary below: 

1) Tolerance: Redwood will allow a transient tolerance where 95th percentile latency requirement may be increased to 750ms for a maximum of 7 consecutive business days. The tolerance window will begin after Redwood deploys the mitigation changes and verifies stable metrics for 24 hours.
2) Credit: A one-time make-good credit capped at 3% of the September pilot invoice will be applied only if 95th > 700ms for more than two calendar days during the tolerance window. This credit is expressly one-time and non-precedent.
3) Operational conditions: Redwood will enable prefix caching and a temporary batching cap; CinderEdge will provide read-only access to the relevant telemetry stream and participate in daily 30-minute calls during the window.
4) Documentation: Legal and commercial will attach a short addendum to the pilot order stating the terms and 'non-amendment' clause.

Next steps:
- Redwood (tessa) to deploy config tonight and send verification snapshot by 09/14 09:00 PT.
- CinderEdge to confirm telemetry access and confirm daily standup cadence.
- Jonas will send the legal addendum for signature.

If that aligns, we'll update the Deal Desk ticket and queue the credit memo workflow.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
